english: You lot aren't even worthy of struggling...
Shatter, body and foolish schemes alike...
Freeze to death within the silver ice...
Have you grasped your own powerlessness?...
Have you grasped your own powerlessness...?
Have you grasped your own powerlessness...?
Something this trivial won't shake my plans...
So you still had the will to resist...
Something this trivial won't shake my plans...
So you still had the will to resist...
This power my clan has pursued...
The fools who stand in my way--
the silver world that stops all!
An offering to those who fall!
Bloom in madness! Barren flowers of silver ice!
